HONEST ABOUT OUR LIMITS

Care starts with transparency.

This is an educational prototype inspired by the ScriptCheck blueprint. It combines selected source-linked rules with an optional server-connected AI model. The model is not trained or clinically validated specifically for ScriptCheck, and its suggestions need professional verification.

It does not diagnose, prescribe, calculate a personal safe dose, contact a professional, or replace a complete medication review. A result with no flags does not mean the medicines are safe.

Ingredients with selected checks

Coverage varies by ingredient. Checks include six medicine pairs, selected anti-inflammatory overlap, exact ingredient duplication and allergy matching, selected kidney/ulcer flags, methotrexate schedule review, and a limited paracetamol daily-total check. Other combinations, brands, formulations, labs and conditions are not covered.

Sources, privacy & next steps

Local checks and on-device text reading stay in your browser. If you explicitly choose AI review, your prescription and entered health details are sent through Netlify to OpenAI. ScriptCheck does not create patient records or log prescription content. We request no stored model response, but provider abuse-monitoring retention may still apply. Reloading clears the browser session. Remove personal identifiers before sharing. Keep downloaded reports private.

The blueprint's clinically validated patient-risk model, professional accounts, verified reviews, care-team notifications and longitudinal records remain future work. AI uncertainty or failure creates a pharmacist-review handoff; it does not contact a pharmacist automatically. This public prototype makes no regulatory or accuracy claims.
